task_completion.description: Construct at least 3 interior partition walls within the building shell.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least three distinct new wall segments drawn inside the main building perimeter in the 2D floor plan or 3D view.

task_completion.description: Place at least 3 doors for separate circulation paths.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify at least three door icons or 3D models placed within the walls to facilitate movement between zones.

task_completion.description: Furnish the judge's area with at least 1 desk, 1 executive chair, and 2 shelves/cabinets.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the designated judge's area, verify the presence of a desk, a high-back executive chair, and two storage units (shelves or cabinets).

task_completion.description: Place at least 22 chairs total for the jury box and public gallery.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count the chairs in the gallery and jury sections; there must be a minimum of 22 chairs visible in these areas combined.

task_completion.description: Place at least 3 tables/desks and 7 chairs for counsel, witness, and clerk areas.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Locate the areas for counsel and staff; verify at least 3 tables/desks and a total of 7 chairs across these specific zones.

task_completion.description: Identify at least 4 zones (e.g., 'Judge', 'Jury', 'Gallery', 'Counsel') using text labels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for text annotations on the 2D floor plan labeling at least four distinct functional areas of the courtroom.
Look for the 'Save As' dialog box with the correct path typed in, or the application title bar reflecting the saved filename 'courtroom.sh3d'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to design the layout.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D plan, and the 3D view, rather than just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-made file other than the starter file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show the incremental placement of walls and furniture items over time.

integrity.description: Furniture items are selected from the Sweet Home 3D catalog.
integrity.visual_evidence: The side panel showing the furniture library should be visible and used to drag items into the plan.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use the starter file 'courtroom_starter.sh3d'. The final output must be saved as '/home/ga/Documents/courtroom.sh3d'. Total furniture count must be at least 35 items. Required zones to label are Judge, Jury, Gallery, and Counsel. Specific minimums: 3 walls, 3 doors, 1 judge desk, 1 executive chair, 2 shelves, 22 gallery/jury chairs, 3 counsel/clerk tables, and 7 counsel/clerk chairs.
